title: Netanyahu is pushing for new Iran attack in bid to stay in power, his rivals warn
summary_full: Before the Israeli election, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu agitated for fresh strikes on Iran, four people with knowledge of the matter said. Opposition leaders remain alarmed.
